slides.hook: why i don't count my warm-up sets

slides.title: warm-ups are prep
slides.text: they get me ready to lift. they're not the work.

slides.title: how many?
slides.text: as many as i need. there's no fixed number.

slides.title: what counts
slides.text: 2 working sets per exercise. 4–8 clean reps. those are the sets i log.

slides.title: why it matters
slides.text: mix warm-ups in and your numbers stop meaning anything week to week.

slides.label: real tip
slides.text: warm-ups get their own button, so working sets stay clean.
